title: Chapter 2818 - 126: Annihilation (Part 3)
content:
Chapter 2818: Chapter 126: Annihilation (Part 3)

This seems to be a tribal signal.

Dan Zhu’s expression changed, and he wanted to kill this Barbarian General immediately.

But this Barbarian General’s face was still smiling insincerely, "Too late... Once the witch smoke is released, a great army will come, and all of you will die, slaughtered and dismembered, you can’t escape..."

The smile on the Barbarian General’s face grew more sinister and rampant.

Dan Zhu wanted to kill this Barbarian General on the spot, but he still turned his head, looking at Mo Hua.

Mo Hua said blandly, "No hurry, we are waiting here as well."

Dan Zhu was taken aback, pondered for a moment, then nodded.

The Barbarian General glanced at Mo Hua, frowned, not understanding why this mere boy in the Foundation Establishment Realm had such authority when speaking.

Even this Golden Core prodigy in exquisite feathered clothing, so terrifyingly strong, had to listen to him?

Could his identity be extraordinary?

But thinking further, the Barbarian General chuckled coldly in his heart.

No matter how extraordinary someone is, in the face of a slaughter by a large group of Barbarian Soldiers, there is only one path — death.

These people, not killing me now, will have to kneel and kowtow to me when the reinforcements arrive.

A gleam of coldness flickered in the Barbarian General’s eyes.

The mountainous forests were desolate and silent. Within less than two hours, hoofbeats came from afar, like an earthquake, and shortly after a billowing dust storm, a large force charged out.

Looking out, there were over two hundred Barbarian Soldiers, all clad in black Barbarian Armor, led by three Golden Core Barbarian Cultivators.

These Golden Cores and Barbarian Soldiers, riding Barbarian horses, encircled Mo Hua and his two companions, sealing off all escape routes.

The leading individual pointed a long spear at Dan Zhu, shouting, "Release Lord Barbarian General."

Dan Zhu’s expression remained unchanged.

The Barbarian General trampled under Dan Zhu’s foot laughed out loud:

"Three fools who don’t know the immensity of heaven and earth dare to lay hands on me? You’re dead this time, kneel and kowtow eighteen times, perhaps I’ll let you die a quicker death."

But Dan Zhu remained silent.

Mo Hua looked at him and asked flatly, "Your men have arrived?"

The Barbarian General sneered, "So what if they have?"

Mo Hua nodded slightly, "Perfect... My people have arrived too."

The Barbarian General’s face changed slightly, just as he was about to speak, he felt a deep tremor from the ground, numbing one side of his face slightly.

This tremor was not from horse hooves, not so noisy.

But rather deep and heavy like a mountain, it was...

A large contingent of Heavy Armored Barbarian Soldiers marching in unison across the ground, causing the tremor.

Moreover, their number was astonishing...

The Barbarian General’s face turned deathly pale, as he struggled to turn his head to look, seeing the distant ground, neat footsteps like thunder "rumbling," approaching in sequence.

Before long, a group of battle-hardened elite soldiers, clad in ghastly Bone Heavy Armor, like a marching army of Monster Beasts, appeared within everyone’s sight.

At a glance, there were over a hundred of them.

And behind these Heavy Armored soldiers, there were over six hundred more elite Barbarian Soldiers also wearing Barbarian Armor.

In total, there were over eight hundred Barbarian Soldiers.

Over eight hundred Barbarian Soldiers adequately equipped with Heavy and Barbarian Armors!

And at the forefront of this army, there were five Golden Core Strong People overseeing it.

Led by five Golden Cores and over a hundred Elite Bone Heavy Armed soldiers, this force of over eight hundred Barbarian Soldiers quickly surrounded the two hundred Barbarian Soldiers summoned by the Barbarian General.

The Barbarian General felt his bones trembling. Even the "reinforcements" he summoned were now no less terrified, as if their souls were frightened out of them.

Mo Hua knew several live captives should be left for interrogation.

But he was not in the mood now and said blandly:

"Slaughter them all..."

Surrounded by heavily armored soldiers and an overwhelming feeling of chilling murderous intent, the Golden Core Barbarian General looked terrified, glaring at Mo Hua:

"You use strength to oppress the weak, slaughtering them all, don’t you feel shameless?"

Mo Hua looked at him impassively, his tone calm, "You cannot only speak of survival of the fittest when you slaughter others..."

"Now you’re the ant, I’m the strong one, if you’re slaughtered, so be it, what’s there to say?"
